text:
Oliver: Heads up — deploybot blocked the canary. Image extract failed due to a stale symlink in the OCI layer, smoke tests failing. Need decision: pin to previous image or attempt rebuild+reupload? Logs pasted below.

Deploy-bot: verify-artifact failed for image redwood/service@sha256:abc123
error: open /layers/sha256/xyz/current: no such file or directory
smoke: healthcheck failed (503)

Jess: Ugh. Is this a registry-side corruption or our image builder cut off the multipart upload?

Sophia: Registry shows 503 spikes around 01:22 UTC, there were a couple of truncated part uploads. Looks like some layers didn't finish being assembled.

Mike: If we trigger a reupload there's a risk the same transient 503 will bite us again. My vote: pin to the last good image sha256:def456 and promote manually. That buys time to rebuild properly. Any compliance/retention issues with re-promoting older image?

Tara: Change window still open for ~30m. I prefer pin+manual promote so we don't chase a flaky registry. We can schedule a clean rebuild + reupload tomorrow morning. +1 to pin. :thumbsup:

Jamie: I can handle the manual promote and smoke run. Will need Deploy-bot to accept a manual promote command and then I'll watch metrics for 15m. Also will add a short-time alert for error-rate > 1% in canary. Command I will run:
```
/deploybot promote --image sha256:def456 --env canary --reason "pin after artifact verify fail"
```

Oliver: Perfect. If we pin, update the release notes draft with a short blurb and include rollback steps (how to revert the pin). Jess — please open a rebuild job PR so we have the reupload plan captured.

Jess: Opening PR now. Also kicking off an ad-hoc reupload with retries but will not promote it automatically:
```
./tools/reupload-image --image=redwood/service:canary --retry=5 --verify-checksums
```

Deploy-bot: Manual promote command queued by Jamie. Status: queued -> deploying -> smoke-run. Will post status updates here. :eyes:

Tara: Thanks everyone — action items: Jamie promote + watch, Jess open PR + keep reupload in flight, Sophia file registry incident if we see more 503s, Mike confirm retention window for old image, Oliver update release notes. We'll reconvene if smoke fails.
